title: Tech Note: Mail Merges with 4D Write Pro
author: Timothy Aaron Penner, Technical Services Engineer, 4D Inc.

historical_commentary.text: 4D Write (classic) is fully retired from 64-bit 4D, so the v6/v7-era conversion paths (32-bit-only legacy plugin, offscreen area, blob conversion) documented here are now purely historical/legacy migration reference; the underlying mail-merge pattern of embedded expressions in 4D Write Pro documents remains the current, valid approach.
related_updates: 4D Write classic and its legacy plugin are gone in current 64-bit 4D, so the 32-bit conversion steps described are obsolete except for archival migration of very old documents
4D Write Pro remains 4D's current document/mail-merge engine, and expression-based mail merges are still built the same conceptual way
